product.name: PAX / FORSAND
product.introText: PAX / FORSAND wardrobe 100x60x236 cm, white: foldable PAX frame (AA-2174072-9), 2 FORSAND doors with KOMPLEMENT soft-closing hinges (AA-2416848-2), KOMPLEMENT clothes rail (AA-938836-3) and 3 shelves. Two people and a step ladder; the frame must be fixed to the wall. The screws and sleeves 100402 / 100644 are only for joining frames.
product.partsSummary: 1x Allen key,  1x Back,  2x Bclip,  1x Bottom,  2x Conn,  2x Conn f,  2x Cover,  2x Door,  2x Eclip,  2x Fdowel,  4x Foot,  8x Hinge,  16x Hscrew,  2x Join screw,  2x Join sleeve,  2x Pclip,  1x Plinth f,  1x Plinth r,  16x Pscrew,  1x Rail,  2x Rail bracket,  4x Rscrew,  3x Shelf,  2x Side,  2x Spacer,  12x Support,  1x Top,  2x Wwasher

steps.title: Stand the frame up
steps.text: Two people: lift the folded frame upright in front of the wall, the arrows on the straps pointing up. Do not cut the straps - pull them off upwards (2x).

steps.title: Unfold the sides
steps.text: Swing both sides open until they stand at right angles to the back.

steps.title: Feet
steps.text: Turn the 4 adjustable feet (10108698) to their lowest position and hook them into the slots at the bottom of the sides (see the inset - foot not unscrewed).

steps.title: Rear plinth
steps.text: Clip the 2 plinth holders (10042526) onto the rear feet and lower the rear plinth into them.

steps.title: Front plinth
steps.text: Push the front plinth onto the front feet and press it down until it clicks. Check the frame is square (inset).

steps.title: Bottom supports and back clips
steps.text: Push the 2 bottom supports (10120505) onto the front feet and clip the 2 back clips (10046278) over the bottom edge of the back.

steps.title: Corner connectors
steps.text: Click the corner connectors R (10042625) and L (10042612) into the top back corners of the sides - check the letters.

steps.title: Top panel
steps.text: From a step ladder, put the top panel in: hook it onto the connector on one side, swing it level so the 4 pins go into the keyhole slots, and slide it back (inset).

steps.title: Lock the top
steps.text: Push up the levers of both corner connectors to lock the top, then click the 2 front connectors (10042543) into the front top corners.

steps.title: Level the frame
steps.text: Adjust the feet with the Allen key (10094315) through the bottom until the frame stands level, then push 2 dowels (101349) into the front feet.

steps.title: Wall spacers and fixing
steps.text: Screw the 2 wall spacers (10046275) through the corner connectors until they touch the wall (max. 22 mm gap). Fix the frame to the wall through the connectors with screws for your wall type (not included) and the washers (100823).

steps.title: Connector covers
steps.text: Click the 2 covers (10042610) onto the corner connectors.

steps.title: Bottom panel
steps.text: Lay the bottom panel onto the supports - the dowels go into its holes.

steps.title: Clothes rail
steps.text: Screw the 2 rail brackets to the sides with 4 screws and click the clothes rail (KOMPLEMENT) into them.

steps.title: Shelves
steps.text: Push 4 shelf supports per shelf into the holes at the heights you want and lay the 3 shelves (KOMPLEMENT) onto them.

steps.title: Hinges onto the doors
steps.text: Lay each door face down and screw 4 hinges (KOMPLEMENT soft-closing) into the hinge cups with 2 screws each; pre-fit the 2 screws of each hinge plate.

steps.title: Hang the doors
steps.text: Hold each door against the frame and screw the hinge plates to the side (2 screws per hinge).

steps.title: Adjust the doors
steps.text: Adjust the hinges with a screwdriver until both doors hang straight with even gaps (sideways, depth and height - see the hinge instructions). Stick on the door bumpers (104663).
